run_generate_clip_text_features: run the script to generate CLIP text embedding features for PASCAL Part categories and save to a numpy file
run_generate_clip_text_features_with_pro: run the script with prompt photo to generate CLIP text embeddings using 'a photo of a' sentence templates
run_generate_clip_text_features_base_onl: run the script with only_base flag to generate CLIP text embeddings using only base PASCAL categories
run_generate_clip_text_features_custom_m: run the script with clip_model ViT-B-32 to generate CLIP text embeddings using a ViT backbone instead of RN50
run_generate_clip_text_features_no_part: run the script without use_part flag to generate CLIP text embeddings using colon-separated category names
